title: The 8 Best Tape Measure with Fractions 2026
h1: The 8 Best Tape Measure with Fractions 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for tape measure with fractions 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at tape measure with fractions 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Milwaukee 48-22-7125 25-Foot Magnetic Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: 25-foot length, Fraction markings every 1/8 inch, 13-foot standout.
strengths: Large, clearly printed fraction denominators at each 1/8-inch increment -- eliminates mental math
13-foot standout allows solo spanning of long distances
Nylon-bonded blade resists kinking and fraying
Milwaukee is the most recommended tape brand among professional woodworkers and carpenters
limitations: Fraction markings on one side only
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Stanley FatMax 33-725 25-Foot Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: 25-foot length, Wide FatMax blade, Fraction markings.
strengths: Wide FatMax blade provides excellent standout -- holds horizontal further than standard-width tapes
Fraction markings are large and clearly printed for fast reading
Blade armor protects the first 6 inches from the most common damage zone
Stanley FatMax is the most recognized quality tape brand worldwide
limitations: Magnetic tip version more expensive than basic FatMax
Wider blade means slightly heavier case

products.name: Tajima G-25BW 25-Foot Shock Resistant Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: Japanese manufactured, Highest blade accuracy, Fraction and metric.
strengths: Tajima Japanese manufacturing produces the most precisely printed fraction markings of anytape
Longest standout in the category -- holds horizontal further than US brands
Fraction markings aligned with metric equivalents on the reverse side
The tape of choice for finish carpenters who demand accuracy
limitations: Less common at local hardware stores

products.name: Klein Tools 9225 25-Foot Double-Hook Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: Fraction scale, High-visibility markings, Trade quality.
strengths: Klein Tools' high-visibility blade uses larger numbers than competitors -- easier to read at arm's length
Fraction scale printed on the blade for each 1/16 increment
Klein quality control is proven in the professional construction trade
Good magnetic tip option available
limitations: Fraction markings are slightly smaller than Milwaukee at the same price
Lower standout than FatMax or Tajima

products.name: DEWALT DWHT36225 25-Foot XP Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: 25-foot length, Fraction markings, Impact-resistant case.
strengths: DeWalt fraction markings are clearly printed with bold denominators at each increment
Impact-resistant case design is more drop-resistant than most alternatives
DeWalt quality is consistent and the brand is trusted in construction environments
Available in most hardware stores for easy in-store purchase
limitations: Fraction markings slightly less prominent than Milwaukee
Standout is adequate but not the best in the category

products.name: Empire Level 637IM 30-Foot Power Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Budget price, Fraction markings, 25-foot length.
strengths: Lowest price for a fraction-marked tape measure
Fraction markings present at standard increments
Good starting tape for woodworkers trying fraction tapes before investing in Milwaukee or Tajima
25-foot capacity covers all standard woodworking measurements
limitations: Fraction markings are smaller and less legible than premium tapes
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Lufkin PHV1425D Power Return 25-Foot Engineer's Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Engineer and fraction scale, 25-foot length, Lufkin accuracy.
strengths: Engineer scale (tenths of a foot) alongside fraction scale on the same blade
Useful for woodworkers who occasionally need engineer measurements for site work or architectural drawings
Lufkin accuracy is the traditional standard for precision measurement
Dual scale reduces the need to carry two tapes
limitations: Dual scale makes the blade slightly more complex to read quickly
Less standout than FatMax or Milwaukee

products.name: FastCap ProCarpenter Standard Reverse 16-Foot Tape Measure
products.blurb: Key specs: Markings on both sides of blade, Reads correctly from both sides, Fraction markings.
strengths: Fraction markings printed on BOTH sides of the blade -- reads correctly from either side
Correct for both left-handed and right-handed users without repositioning
FastCap is a professional cabinet shop brand -- quality exceeds general hardware brands
Eliminates the need to flip the tape to read from the correct side
limitations: Dual-side printing adds cost over single-side tapes
Less widely available than Milwaukee or Stanley
features: Markings on both sides of blade

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
